newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber mostly firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber mostly firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were steady to firmer in the after-hours trade on Friday, as moderate buying interest continued from the day session, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.6 yen per kg higher than the day's close. The benchmark April contract was up 0.4 yen at 143.3 yen. Volume was thin at 4,047 lots traded.

During the day, prices firmed on a view that further rises in Japanese rubber stocks will be limited, encouraging scattered buying. "The direction hinges on the currency market. We are concerned about signs showing the dollar's rise may have stalled," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk
